g.text: Navarro main deposit: broad microglial RNA description
Point area = raw-count detection fraction (0–100%); × = gene absent. One observed pool per condition.
WT5/Mut5: main-figure pair (caption 0.02 mg/mL); WT1/Mut1: other-concentration pair, numeric mapping unverified.
Original broad annotation; downstream microglial exclusion not recreated. No population tests or uncertainty intervals.
